directories.name: Hacker News Show HN
directories.copy:
Show HN: audited price badges and four embeddable AI cost calculators

We publish dated price receipts for the tools in the catalog (https://aitoolsessentials.com/tools/) and four browser calculators that do not invent a per-token rate. Vendors can embed the badge; the iframe calculators are at https://aitoolsessentials.com/embeds/.

directories.name: Reddit r/SaaS
directories.copy:
Data post: published coding-seat prices, not a token estimate.

Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf do not publish a dollar per prompt. The calculator picks the published plan for the workload and leaves overage at $0. https://aitoolsessentials.com/compare/ai-coding-assistants/

directories.name: Reddit r/LocalLLaMA
directories.copy:
Local workbench planner plus the audited price ledger for hosted seats you might drop.

https://aitoolsessentials.com/local-ai-planner/ plans memory and model size. The hosted-seat overlap receipt is the bill slasher embed: https://aitoolsessentials.com/embed/ai-bill-slasher/

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.copy:
AI Tools Essentials — audited price badges and embeddable cost calculators.

Dated official prices, a badge vendors can embed, and four calculators (coding seats, voice and video minutes, automation tasks, overlap bill). https://aitoolsessentials.com/embeds/

directories.name: AlternativeTo
directories.copy: Independent pricing ledger for AI tools. Reviews cite the official pricing page and the check date. Not a ranked marketplace. https://aitoolsessentials.com/

directories.name: G2
directories.copy: Methodology: editorial scores are not hands-on lab results and are not for sale. https://aitoolsessentials.com/legal/editorial-methodology.html
